invariants.rationale: The Batch object is used without null checks, so it must be non-null during text drawing.
The BitmapFont object is used for rendering text, so it is required to be non-null.
The loop draws at most until linesBreak.size, hence size may be less than or equal to the iteration bound.
The lowest drawn y-position (final offsetY) is less than or equal to the initial y argument, as offsetY is reduced each loop.
This is just to show a true relation, but not meaningful; can be omitted for more meaningful ones.
